__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Existing Prometheus datasource
__inputs.description: Select the existing Prometheus datasource that scrapes the CWO exporter.

description: CWO-associated Codex sessions and agents, recorded tokens, turn outcomes and turn time. External contractor reviews and workflow events use their existing CWO files.

panels.title: Session scan
panels.description: Profile-wide health; Project and Session filters do not apply. Whole-profile session source scan age and coverage. Partial means files are pending or gaps/errors are present. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: time() - min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_timestamp_seconds[2m]))
min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m]))

panels.title: Workflow scans
panels.description: Profile-wide health; Project and Session filters do not apply. Configured workflow audit scan age and coverage; CLI review coverage when enabled. Read means configured sources only. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: time() - min(last_over_time({__name__=~"cwo_audit_scan_timestamp_seconds|cwo_review_scan_timestamp_seconds"}[2m]))
min(last_over_time({__name__=~"cwo_audit_collection_complete|cwo_review_collection_complete"}[2m]))

panels.title: CWO activity · selected projects and sessions
Sessions with CWO
panels.description: Sessions with a structured CWO skill block or supported CWO helper command, and activity in the selected range. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count(max by (project_id, session_id) ((cwo_codex_session_info{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}",kind="session"} and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}"}) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}"} >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}"} <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}"}))))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Associated agents
panels.description: Subagent sessions associated directly or through a CWO-associated parent before their creation, with activity in the selected range. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: CWO helper commands
panels.description: Recorded completed command items invoking a supported CWO helper within the selected range. Includes failed attempts; separate from model jobs and audit preparations. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Recorded session tokens
panels.description: Whole-session recorded token totals for the selected CWO-associated sessions and agents. Includes earlier session history; this is not CWO-exclusive cost. Missing or conflicting usage is omitted, so the total can be a lower bound. Token scale: K = thousand; Mil = million; Bil = billion; Tri = trillion. Tables show exact counts. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: CWO-associated session activity
panels.description: Sessions and subagents with CWO activity in the selected range. Tokens, completed/failed turns and turn time cover their recorded session history. Turn time is the sum of reported turn durations, not assignment wall time; a completed turn does not establish that an assignment succeeded. Model / effort shows the latest selected settings. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: CWO helper commands by tool
panels.description: Recorded helper invocations completed within the selected range, for the selected projects and sessions. Repeated scrapes count once. Compound commands can have unknown helper outcomes; counts include those attempts. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: topk(10, count by (tool) ((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id, tool, outcome) (cwo_codex_cwo_command_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}"}) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id, tool, outcome) (cwo_codex_cwo_command_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"${project:regex}",session_id=~"${session:regex}"}) <= ($__to / 1000))))

panels.title: Workflow events by type · all projects
panels.description: Unique source-time events by type across all configured audit logs. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: topk(10, count by (event_type) (((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000)))))

panels.title: External contractor reviews
panels.description: External contractor review attempts collected from CWO records. Shows the launching Codex session, whether each attempt completed or failed, requested and reported models, requested effort, token usage and duration. Includes attempts launched during the selected time range. Project and Session filter reviews through their proven launching session. Reviews without a proven source session appear only when both filters are All. Currently supports retained Claude review records. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).
